# Bug Report

Describe a reproducible problem with RackNES or CV Genie.
No source build or coding experience is required to report a Rack problem.

<!-- Search existing issues first. Fill in the relevant sections and remove

<!-- What happened, and what did you expect? If this worked in an earlier

## ROM, Settings, And Evidence

<!-- For ROM-dependent problems, identify the game or homebrew, region,
revision, and mapper if known. Include a checksum if available, not the ROM.
Describe relevant clock knob/CV settings, controller gates, HANG, and the
order of SAVE, RESET, and LOAD actions. For audio problems, list the connected
individual outputs and MIX routing. For CV Genie, include placement, selected
game map, row assignments, voltages, and continuous/toggle settings.
For performance issues, include module count, audio buffer size, and CPU.
Attach screenshots or relevant Rack log excerpts for display errors/crashes.
Remove personal paths or other private information before sharing logs. -->
